letter.company_line: Stanfield's RPD has been a surveying drafting firm in Spring Hill, Brisbane since 1991.
letter.subject: Cadet Survey Draftsperson (SEEK 95815474)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Cadet Survey Draftsperson role at Stanfield's. A cadet role with on the job training in a long established surveying drafting firm is the kind of start in drafting I am looking for.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage. My Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) included surveying.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, where I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

I have not used SurvaCad or worked in the surveying industry yet, so I would be learning both from your team. I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa and I am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane for the right role.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

checklist: Search Gmail in:anywhere for Stanfield's and SEEK 95815474 before applying (Gmail was not reachable on this tick)
Decide whether a move to Brisbane suits you; the letter only says open to discussing relocation
Open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95815474 and press Apply (no screening questions listed)
Attach the resume and cover letter from this folder; wages are discussed at interview
